title: Shaam ke Zindan
body:
shaam ke zindan se ye aayi sada
dam ghuta jaata hai mera qaid mein
aao ammu tum ko mera waasta
dam ghuta jaata hai mera qaid mein
<<DIVIDER>>
mai karun kab tak tumhara intezar
pyasi aankhein har ghadi hai ashk baar
lene aaoge mujhe tum kab bhala
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laakh apne dil ko behlati hoo mai
par andheron se dari jaati hoo mai
mil rahi hai mujhko ye kaisi saza
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se shaam tak ka ye safar
sakhtiyan jheli hai maine raah bhar
aur is par zulm ye zindan ka
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi mein har ghadi thi roshni
dekhte hi dekhte shaam aa gayi
ab andheron se faqat hai waasta
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya karun kuch aql mein aata nahi
koi dukhiya par taras khaata nahi
kab rukega zulm ka ye silsila
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
neel chehre par hai kurta khoon se tar
mai bahot royi hoo ammu raat bhar
poochta koi nahi hai kya hua
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
umr choti hai bahot mai kya karun
aur kab tak zulm se tanha ladun
ho na aisa dam nikal jaye mera
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein har ek shaam o sehar
dil ko tadpaati rahi yaad e padar
aaj tak toota nahi ye silsila
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kab ho mujhko mera ghar naseeb
mai khadi hoo maut se itna khareeb
dijiye dhaaras mujhe aa kar chacha
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein jeene ki tamanna hi nahi
meri turbat ab bane shayad yahin
muntazir hai dil faqat ab maut ka
dam ghuta jaata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sitam ko sehte sehte thak chuki
qaid khane mein sakina mar gayi
waqt e aakhir bhi raza nauha ye tha
dam ghuta jaata hai...
author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi
